subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Fake Charity Scam
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Fake Charity Scam.

hook.text: After a disaster, donations pour into a charity that sounds legitimate — but doesn't exist.

buildup.text: Fake charities use names nearly identical to real ones and launch within hours of a tragedy.

discovery.text: The FTC found that some fake charities kept over 95% of donations for personal use.

twist.text: Donors get tax receipts, feel good, and never learn their money helped nobody.

climax.text: Emotional urgency after disasters bypasses the critical thinking that would catch the fraud.

punchline.text: Compassion without verification funds the scammer.

quiz.question: When do fake charity scams spike?
